coverage_note: Almost the whole lesson (11:13-1:00:35) is a listening drill on causative/feeling verbs (Amal says a verb, Medi translates to English); speaking Arabic is only the warm-up 06:26-10:31 plus a few lines. Listening comprehension mistakes are written with mode=listening. Many Medi lines are Latin-transliterated by the engine (matahammasi, intikharabti il safra, bizah). No echo-candidates file for 09-19. 07:26 'ألفين تنين وتلات' is engine for 'tnein u tult' (chat tentan u tult) - right, not a row. Year said as 2027 (ألفين وسبعة عشرين) passed with ممتاز - not flagged.

rows.medi_said: This is it today. تسعة عشرين.
rows.why: He said 29 for the date 19; Amal said '19' and he then said تسعة عشر.

rows.medi_said: I said, uh, ستة عشر ستة
rows.why: He gave the month as 6; Amal questioned ستة؟ and gave تسعطاش تسعة (19/9), chat 'tese3ta3sh tes3a'.

rows.medi_said: تسعش ستة. ... Uh, تسعة عشر ستة.
rows.why: He used the MSA form تسعة عشر; Amal voiced the spoken تسعطاش (chat tese3ta3sh); he went back to تسعة عشر after her.

rows.medi_said: اليوم الجو بتغي-- بتغير كتير.
rows.amal_said: So تغير، no be. ... It changed؟
rows.chat: el-jaw el-yoam t8ayyar kteer u shob mish m8ayyem
rows.why: He used the present b- form for something that already happened; Amal: 'So تغير, no be', he: 'past tense, you're right'.
rows.english: The weather today changed a lot.

rows.medi_said: أب الامبارح or أب الامبارح? أب الامبارح.
rows.amal_said: قبل امبارح or أول امبارح some people say.
rows.why: He put el- on امبارح inside 'day before yesterday'; Amal recast it without el- (engine wrote أب for أول).

rows.medi_said: أبيض. أبيض. ... بلوز أبيض
rows.why: بلوزة is feminine so the colour must be بيضا; Amal said بيضة (=بيضا) right after his أبيض; he then switched to قميص (chat 2amees rasmi abyad).

rows.medi_said: بنطلون، أزرق، كمي
rows.why: He said كمي (unclear word, maybe engine) for 'dark'; Amal supplied غامق and he repeated it; chat azra2 8aame2.

rows.medi_said: Matahammasi... Uh, Lisa ma-- Or matahammasi Lisa.
rows.why: He dropped the you-form te- of the t- verb (ma ta7ammasi); Amal recast ما تتحمسي لسه and he said 'Oh, that's right'.

rows.medi_said: bizah.
rows.why: Asked for 'bored' he gave بيزهّق (boring, the verb); Amal: 'That's boring' and gave زهقان.

rows.medi_said: you are tired of me.
rows.why: He took تعبتني as 'you are tired of me'; Amal said that would be تعبت مني.

rows.medi_said: Why did you smile to a male or why did she smile?
rows.why: He read بتضحك as past; Amal asked did or do, he fixed to present.

rows.medi_said: Oh, you said... Okay, I was sad.
rows.why: He heard زهقت as زعلت (sad); Amal corrected.

rows.medi_said: What boring hap-- What happened boring?
rows.why: He took بيزعل as boring; Amal: No, بيزعل not بيزهق.

rows.medi_said: He will not, he will not bore you.
rows.why: He heard the I-form as he-form; Amal corrected.

rows.medi_said: Were you sad from what happened?
rows.amal_said: Very close. بس مش sad. انزعجتي.
rows.why: He took انزعجتي as sad; Amal: not sad.

rows.medi_said: so don't be tired of me.
rows.amal_said: That's ما تتعبي مني. ما تعبيني.
rows.why: He took the causative as 'be tired of me'; Amal corrected.

rows.medi_said: She laughed at him.
rows.why: He heard علي as عليه; Amal repeated علي and he fixed.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, they apologized. Present tense.
rows.why: He called اتأسفوا present; Amal: no, past.

rows.medi_said: Oh, khirbat. Uh, she ruined the trip.
rows.why: He took خربت (got ruined) as 'she ruined'; Amal said no.

rows.medi_said: who enjoyed from us?
rows.why: He heard معنا as منا; Amal: with us.

rows.medi_said: you guys don't, don't be annoyed.
rows.why: He took تزعلوا as annoyed; Amal questioned, he fixed to sad.

rows.medi_said: You guys don't be annoyed.
rows.why: He read the causative as 'be annoyed'; Amal corrected.

rows.medi_said: They made us sad.
rows.why: He heard -ni as 'us'; Amal repeated and he fixed.

rows.medi_said: So it made me happy...
rows.amal_said: صح، it made happy، بس is it past or present؟
rows.why: He read بيبسطني as past; Amal asked past or present.
